_note: Country and jurisdiction pairs that checks/check_sources.py section 9 would flag, confirmed against official sources to have no measure aimed at that country (standing decision 14). Guinea-Bissau|ca: Canada has no regulation aimed at Guinea-Bissau; its Current sanctions page lists none. The UN resolution 2048 travel ban reaches Canada only through the general inadmissibility rule in the Immigration and Refugee Protection Act, section 35.1, which is not a country measure. https://www.international.gc.ca/world-monde/international_relations-relations_internationales/sanctions/current-actuelles.aspx?lang=eng ; https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/acts/I-2.5/page-6.html (checked 12 Nov 2026)
Guinea|ca: Canada's Current sanctions page has no Guinea entry, and its issue-based entries (Terrorism; Extremist Settler Violence; corrupt foreign officials) are not aimed at Guinea. https://www.international.gc.ca/world-monde/international_relations-relations_internationales/sanctions/current-actuelles.aspx?lang=eng (checked 12 Nov 2026)
